description:
Free, offline dictation for Windows. Hold Ctrl+Win and talk into any app. Speech runs on-device, with no cloud and no subscription.

VoiceWave is a free, open-source dictation app for Windows. Hold Ctrl+Win, talk, and the text lands in whatever app you're using, including terminals. Speech is transcribed on your PC with Parakeet (default) or Whisper models, using any GPU through Vulkan or the CPU.

- Local-only transcription (no audio leaves your device)
- Global hotkey push-to-talk and toggle dictation
- Say "press enter" to submit after the text lands
- Custom dictionary words for names and jargon
- Direct insert with clipboard and history fallbacks
Speech model downloads now survive a bad connection, and say what went wrong
when they can't.
Fixed
- Speech model downloads survive a dropped connection. If the network
  stalls or drops (for example when the PC sleeps), the download waits a
  moment and picks up from where it stopped, for up to about two minutes
  without progress, which covers a laptop waking from sleep. It also works
  with antivirus or company networks that check secure connections with
  their own certificate.
- A failed download says why. Instead of a generic error, you see what
  went wrong (no connection, blocked secure connection, disk full, file held
  by another program) and what to do next.
